comment: Enables Google Content Experiments (A/B testing) integration for the storefront.
modal: When **Yes**, Google Content Experiments code is injected for A/B testing. Applies only when the associated Google Analytics integration is enabled. Can differ per website or store view.

comment: Enables Google Content Experiments (A/B testing) integration for Google Analytics 4.
modal: When **Yes**, Google Content Experiments code is injected for A/B testing under the Google Analytics 4 integration. Applies only when Google Analytics 4 is enabled. Can differ per website or store view.
